patterns.explanation: person:411 and person:412 are linked through 2 independent observed channels (CALL, TRANSACTION), each recorded in a separate dataset. Multiple independent channels are harder to explain as coincidence than one channel with many records, which is why the count is over channels and not over records.

Potential transaction pattern requiring review: value returns to its origin along person:149 -> person:411 -> person:412 -> person:149, a closed circuit of 3 persons carrying 325973.43 INR across 3 observed transactions. A circuit is a shape, not a finding; the listed transaction records are the whole of the basis.

Potential transaction pattern requiring review: person:411 sits at the centre of one source sending to 6 distinct receivers, across 6 observed transactions totalling 1412228.33 INR (threshold: 5 counterparties). Many counterparties is a shape common to legitimate activity as well; it is a reason to look, not a conclusion.
